indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Child Nutrition Program Fraud
indicators.flag: A customer is a company or NPO serving as a sponsor for a government benefit program that suddenly receives and disburses a significant number of reimbursements in a short timeframe inconsistent with the customer profile of other similar entities.
indicators.red_flag: Sponsor account: burst reimbursement inflow + rapid disbursement out-of-pattern vs peer entities
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Child Nutrition Program Fraud
